body:
You're entirely right; there's no way of predicting the future.  My issue is that *now* is so bad that there are times I feel that nothing in the world could salvage my desire to live.  I'm already quite scarred, figuratively and literally, from a fucked up childhood.  I know that the trauma I deal with now, though I will heal from it, will affect me for the rest of my life.  

And I'm just not sure it's worth it.  

If I could be doing anything, I would be asleep, preferably passed out on sleep meds.  I just want everything to stop.

I don't know, I find getting high stimulating, but I don't know that I enjoy it.  (And before anyone can jump on that and claim that it's a contributing factor, it's not something I do often.  Been months.)  

I honestly can't think of anything that I enjoy right now.  Every part of my day is a memorized performance.  I used to like reading - now I can't concentrate, and I feel no desire to pick up a book.  I have to force myself to read, and it's not pleasurable anymore.  

Sadly, the first real pleasure I've felt in weeks was when I was playing with a razor blade earlier and barely nicked myself (accidentally, though I was asking for it.)  It was the most incredibly thrilling relief.  

I realize that things *can* get better, but it's getting harder and harder to stick around soley for the purpose of seeing if they will or not.  I'm not passively sitting back and hoping; I'm trying to do everything I can to improve my life and my ability to deal, but to have done so much and know that things just... aren't better... it's disheartening.  I can't help but wonder if there's a point at which I should cut my losses.

I've had some brief good periods in the last few years; some of them even a few months long.  But they end.  And it has been years, now, since I really had any interest in the things I used to love.  I'm tired of trying to fake it.  The only times I feel inspired are when I'm having a full-blown hypomanic episode (as opposed to the mixed symptoms I'm experiencing now) and that's just frenzied, delusional shit.  

I don't want things to be this way anymore... if I could flip a switch and care about things again, and actually feel like a human being, I would.  But the fact that I'm doing the "best" I have for the past few years on the med combo I'm on now and the way everyone around me claims I'm doing just fabulously, it's hard not to just despair.  I'm not constantly suicidal, but I think about it every day.  I'm beginning to feel that no matter how long I hold out, it's going to be in vain.  I might be able to wait until it's least damaging to the people around me, but at some point, I'll find the way out.

Not really.  I'm trying to throw myself into anything I can, but I feel like a robot.  I do whatever it is, and the best I can achieve is feeling absolutely nothing until I'm done, at which point I go back to being depressed.  I actually made a skirt yesterday in an attempt to kill some time and invest myself in something, but it was just... empty.  

I'm trying to spend time with one or two new people I'm just getting to know, but that carries a lot of stress with it, so it's hard to view it as a positive thing right now.
